user.title: KK HMI
user.description: Address of the HMI on your network (the local channel, default port 443). Next you will need a one-time code from the KK app.

enroll.title: Enter the code from the app
enroll.description: In the KK app open the HMI, tap "Add local client" (role viewer, label home-assistant) and type the code it shows for {host} here. The code is valid for two minutes and works once.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate the HMI
reauth_confirm.description: The HMI at {host} no longer accepts this Home Assistant (access was revoked, or the HMI was reset). In the KK app tap "Add local client" again and type the new code.

error.wrong_code: The code is wrong. Five wrong codes lock the window; if it is gone, open a new one in the app.
error.window_closed: No enrolment window is open on the HMI (expired, already used, or locked after five wrong codes). Tap "Add local client" in the app again.
error.rejected: The HMI rejected this client certificate.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the HMI. Check the address and that Home Assistant is on the same network.
error.pin_mismatch: The HMI presented a different key than the one just enrolled. Try again with a new code.
error.auth_failed: The HMI refused this client right after enrolling. Open a new window in the app and try again.
error.too_many_clients: The HMI already has 4 local clients. Close one (another phone or tab), then open a new window and try again.
error.wrong_device: This HMI is a different device than the one configured. Use the code of the original HMI.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

too_many_clients.title: The HMI has no free local client slot
too_many_clients.description: The HMI at {host} already has 4 local clients connected, so Home Assistant cannot connect (close code 4290). Disconnect another client (for example a phone app); Home Assistant keeps retrying and this entry clears itself once it gets in.
